name: HOTEL CASA SAN AGUSTIN

address.street: Calle de la Universidad No 36-44 Cartagena

insider_take: This 17th-century convent turned luxury boutique hotel sits in the heart of Cartagena's UNESCO World Heritage old town, where colonial charm meets Caribbean sophistication.
whats_special: Hotel Casa San Agustín seamlessly blends three historic colonial buildings, including parts of a former Augustinian convent from 1621. The property features original coral stone walls, wooden balconies, and a stunning central courtyard with a refreshing plunge pool. Located on a quiet cobblestone street, you're steps from the iconic Clock Tower and Plaza de los Coches.
pro_tip: Book a room overlooking the interior courtyard for the most authentic colonial experience, and time your arrival for sunset drinks on the rooftop terrace with panoramic views of the Caribbean Sea.
dont_miss: The hotel's prime location puts you within a 2-minute walk of Cartagena's famous city walls (Las Murallas) and the vibrant nightlife of Plaza Santo Domingo. The nearby Palace of the Inquisition and Gold Museum offer fascinating glimpses into the city's complex colonial history.
pros: Historic colonial architecture in UNESCO World Heritage old town
Intimate boutique property with personalized service
Prime location within walking distance of major attractions
Authentic cultural immersion in Cartagena's heritage district
cons: Limited modern amenities due to historic building constraints
Smaller room sizes typical of colonial architecture
